data.name: Avista Villa
data.hero_sub: Clean lines, walls of glass, and a private horizon-edge pool - a contemporary house built entirely around the light.
data.summary: For groups who want a contemporary layout, wide sea views and a pool that sits level with the horizon. Living, kitchen and terraces stay open to the water throughout the day.

children.text: A three bedroom villa with private pool

Located just 120 meters from Vourvourou's main beach, Villa Avista is a cozy two - floor residence, fully equipped, set in one of the area's most desirable locations. Surrounded by olive and fruit trees, it offers panoramic views of Vourvourou's five small islands and the surrounding green hills.

data.seo_title: Avista Private Resort, The garden estate · Vourvourou
data.seo_description: Avista Private Resort: a walled garden estate with a generous pool, shaded patios and BBQ, made for long family summers in Vourvourou.

data.quote: The private villa is amazing and very spacious. The garden is just stunning — full of greenery with olive trees all around. A must-stay experience!
The hosts display the best customer service and hospitality I have ever experienced. The facilities are amazing and the grounds beautifully kept — a home away from home.
The hosts were extremely helpful and communication was flawless. The real gem is the big green garden with olive trees and the pool beside it. Highly recommend.
The rooms were nicely decorated and spotless, and the swimming pool is a great spot to relax at the end of the day. Atanasis is a great host — highly recommended!
Wonderful family-run property whose hosts were extremely helpful. Peaceful, beautiful pool, close to the beach and very clean. Would recommend to family and friends.
The host, Dimitri, was very kind and welcoming, with great recommendations. The view was excellent and the house very clean and cozy. Thank you for the beautiful experience!
If I could, I would rate 11/10! One of the best villas we have ever stayed in Chalkidiki. We loved the privacy — no neighbouring houses close by and a real connection with nature.
The villa was perfect for a larger group — no neighbours nearby, spacious, a large pool and beds of high hotel quality. The host was very friendly. A perfect escape.
The owners are wonderful people! The service and cleanliness are at a very high level. The villa is 10/10 — everything was beyond perfect!
The facilities are superb and the location beautiful — everything has been thought of. The birthday cake gesture was lovely, and our contact was very helpful. Thank you for everything.
Excellent from front to back. There were eight of us — six adults and two toddlers — and it was perfect.
Wonderful house and super friendly hosts.

data.brand_blurb: Two private villas in Vourvourou, where pine shade meets the Aegean. Sithonia, Halkidiki, Greece.

data.hero_sub: Private Villas for rent in the heart of Sithonia
data.intro_lead: Inspired by the raw beauty of the landscape of Sithonia and the beautiful blend of lush greenery and crystal-blue waters that defines the Vourvourou area.

children.text: Avista Villas offers privacy and a place where you can reconnect with nature while feeling at home.

With the wandering spirit of our guests in mind, we have created a setting that awakens the senses through eco-friendly materials and invites you to experience unique moments of mindfulness, serenity, and complete tranquillity.

data.location_summary: Vourvourou sits on Sithonia's eastern coast, where pine trees meet sheltered water and the islets of Diaporos sit just offshore. It is quiet, shallow and easy for families, with tavernas and small beaches close by.

data.hero_title: Discover the beautiful destinations of our area!

children.text: A string of nine small bays on the middle finger of Halkidiki, edged with pine and looking out to the islets of Diaporos. Calm, shallow water and some of the clearest sea in the Aegean.
